title: Two-term dilogarithms, mixed-base Nahm sums, and Fricke symmetry
summary: We study the arithmetic constraints that two-term Rogers dilogarithm relations impose on rank-two Nahm systems with mixed denominator steps. Monomial complement equations give a uniform conversion to quadratic data in every algebraic degree. Within a specified ten-record simplest-cubic family, positive coupling, positive definiteness, and integer-valued exponents leave, for m > 2, exactly the steps (1,3), (1,13), and (1,31).
